beats.subline: Wednesday, November 11, 2026 close — a broad rebound from Tuesday's hot-CPI selloff, led by a CoreWeave earnings beat.
beats.body: Stocks rebounded from Tuesday's hot inflation-driven selloff as the VIX fell more than 10%; CoreWeave jumped roughly 26% after beating Q3 revenue estimates and raising guidance, lifting chip and AI-infrastructure shares, while the 10-year Treasury yield held near 5%.

beats.headline: US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks resume in Abu Dhabi after nine-month gap
beats.body: Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff led the first trilateral US-Russia-Ukraine session since February, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling the opening round 'very productive' but cautioning a deal isn't imminent; Ukraine's Zelensky said talks centered on prisoner exchanges and security guarantees, while the two sides remain far apart on territory and NATO membership.

beats.headline: Taiwan logs fresh PLA aircraft and naval activity around its territory
beats.body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported seven PLA aircraft sorties, seven PLA Navy vessels, and two China Coast Guard ships operating around the island in its latest 24-hour count, continuing the near-daily pattern of Chinese military activity around Taiwan this month.

beats.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after board probe into affair and spying allegations
beats.body: Nvidia's board announced Huang stepped down as president, CEO and director effective immediately, naming CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and lead director Harvey Jones the company's first board chair; the move follows Huang's admission of an affair with a Megaspeed executive US intelligence officials suspected of passing information to Beijing, and shares fell as much as 10% in premarket trading before paring losses.
